mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille path (for home states party to the Hague Apostille Convention): notarization by a local notary, followed by issuance of an Apostille by the home state's designated Apostille Competent Authority. Consular Legalization path (for home states not party to the Convention): notarization by a local notary, followed by legalization by the home state's Ministry of Foreign Affairs and then legalization by the Consular Office of the Embassy of the People's Republic of China in that home state. The Apostille and Consular Legalization routes are mutually exclusive and must never be chained.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: All UBOs, directors, and senior management must undergo mandatory screening against the following databases before incorporation: (1) the UN Security Council Consolidated List, (2) the US OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) List and all sanctions programs administered by OFAC, (3) the EU consolidated financial sanctions list, (4) the UK HM Treasury consolidated sanctions list, (5) the Chinese Ministry of Public Security and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs sanction lists, and (6) professional PEP databases with a minimum three-year lookback period. Screening must include fuzzy matching and phonetic transliteration checks to avoid false negatives. The screening results must be documented, retained for at least ten years, and filed with the local SAMR/PBOC upon request. Enhanced due diligence is triggered if any direct or indirect UBO holds a political position, appears on any sanctions list, or has a risk score above the 7/10 threshold. All records must be updated at least annually in accordance with the Beneficial Owner Information Measures, effective 1 November 2024.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: National Enterprise Name Self-Declaration and Pre-registration System administered by the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) through the National Integrated Online Government Service Platform (gjzwfw.gov.cn) and the online service portal of the local municipal SAMR, such as Shanghai or Beijing, where the registered office will be located.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The Chinese statutory name of a Sino-foreign equity joint venture is mandatory and must be composed exclusively of simplified Chinese characters, without pinyin or Roman letters (except for permitted registered trademark elements). The name follows a four-tier mandatory structure: (1) Administrative division (e.g., city or province); (2) Distinctive trade name, which may be the Chinese phonetic transliteration of the foreign investor's corporate name, provided it is not identical or confusingly similar to a prior name in the same industry; (3) Industry or business characteristics (e.g., Engineering Design, CAD, BIM) expressed in Chinese; and (4) Legal form: Co., Ltd. or Limited Liability Company. The English name is not a statutory registration but may be declared on the business license as an additional name; it must be a consistent translation of the Chinese name and must not contain 'China' unless the entity is licensed as a national enterprise. A phonetic transliteration must match the official name of the foreign investor and be distinguishable in the National Enterprise Name Database.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon receiving a written name-rejection notice from the SAMR, the applicant has 15 working days to file a reconsideration application with the same SAMR office. That office must issue a decision within 15 working days. If the reconsideration is denied, the applicant may, within 60 days of the decision, initiate administrative reconsideration at the next higher-level SAMR, or, within 6 months from the original rejection, file an administrative lawsuit in the competent People's Court. The appeal submission must include the original rejection notice, the proposed name in Chinese, a legal explanation of why the name meets the regulatory naming rules, and proof of the applicant's legal authority. Alternatively, the applicant may immediately re-tender a different name without prejudice. No appeal fee is charged by SAMR for the reconsideration, but court action may require an administrative suit fee of RMB 50.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office or commercial mailbox addresses are categorically rejected by local municipal SAMRs and the State Taxation Administration for the purpose of establishing a registered legal address. Each application for a business license requires a legitimate, non-residential physical address evidenced by a valid property ownership certificate or lease agreement registered with the local housing and construction authority. For the ISIC 7110 CAD/BIM outsourcing industry, tax authorities routinely deny tax registration if the address is a registered commercial mailbox, because such arrangements do not demonstrate substantial business presence. Banks also reject virtual offices when opening corporate accounts, as they require physical presence from the outset. Therefore, the company must lease or own an actual office space, or use the address of a local free-trade zone business premises if a valid lease is in place and a site inspection is possible.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: For a new Sino-foreign equity JV in the engineering and CAD/BIM sector (low AML risk tier), the likelihood of an unannounced physical inspection is estimated at 25% within the first six months of registration, increasing to 40% if the enterprise declares tax-free or low-revenue status. The inspection checklist includes: (1) mismatch between registered address and actual operations; (2) abnormal VAT invoices; (3) a small number of employees relative to declared revenue; (4) non-corresponding office furnishings; (5) multiple enterprises registered at the same address; and (6) failure to display the company name plate at the entrance. Inspections are performed by the Municipal Taxation Bureau and SAMR, often jointly. To mitigate, a physical lease of at least 10 square metres with a visible company sign and a filed tamper-proof lease contract is required.

incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum registered capital and no blocked escrow account requirement applies to this foreign-invested services company outside the Foreign Investment Negative List. Subscribed capital must be fully paid within five years from issuance of the business license under Article 47 of the PRC Company Law (2023 Revision). Non-cash contributions are permitted under Article 48. The JV Contract and Articles of Association govern exact currency, amount and contribution schedule.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
PRO-FORMA FIRST BOARD OF DIRECTORS RESOLUTION OF CN_JV_LTD (THE COMPANY)

ADOPTED BY WRITTEN UNANIMOUS CONSENT on [date] under the Articles of Association and Articles 59, 67 and 68 of the PRC Company Law (2023 Revision).

WHEREAS the Company has been established as a foreign-invested limited liability company in the legal form commonly referred to as a Sino-Foreign Equity Joint Venture; and
WHEREAS the original shareholders have executed the Joint Venture Contract and the Articles of Association; and
WHEREAS the first board is authorized to take all actions necessary to perfect incorporation, corporate governance, banking facilities and the adoption of the registered office.

NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED AS FOLLOWS:

1. Incorporation and Share Capital. The board ratifies and approves the filing of the Company Establishment Registration Application with the State Administration for Market Regulation and the implementation of the Joint Venture Contract. The registered capital is fixed at the amount stated in the Articles, subscribed by each shareholder in the currency and percentages set out therein. The board confirms that each subscription shall be paid in full within five years after issuance of the business license in accordance with Article 47 of the Company Law. No minimum escrow or blocked account is required by law for this services company.

2. Adoption of Registered Office. The registered office of the Company is approved and adopted at the address specified in the Articles. The Chairman or General Manager is authorized to execute and deliver a lease, accept legal process at that address and file the registered address with SAMR.

3. Banking Authorization. The board designates [bank name and branch] as the principal depository bank. The Chairman, General Manager and Finance Manager are individually authorized to open bank accounts, execute account documents, apply for wire transfer and Wise payment rail facilities and maintain signatory mandates. All payments require dual-manager approval consistent with the internal control policy.

4. Statutory Officers. Effective immediately, the following officers are appointed: [name] as Chairman of the Board and Legal Representative; [name] as General Manager; [name] as Finance Manager; and [name] as Supervisor. The Legal Representative is authorized to sign regulatory filings, contracts, tax instruments and bank forms.

5. Corporate Governance and Seal Charter. The board adopts the Company charter for seals, internal financial controls, banking AML procedures and record retention.

6. General Authorization. The Chairman and General Manager, jointly, are authorized to execute all ancillary documents and to instruct counsel, notaries and accountants to complete the incorporation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Pre-Approval and Legal Feasibility Screening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: SAMR National Enterprise Name Registration Online Service Platform; local Municipal Market Supervision Administration
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a proposed Chinese legal name, transliterated for these records, containing the administrative district, a distinctive trade name, an industry characteristic corresponding to engineering design and BIM services, and the legal form suffix. The SAMR system will automatically match the name against the national prohibited-name database, identical-name database and protection lists of well-known marks. If the proposed name is available, the system reserves it for six months. The applicant shall upload identity documents of the proposed legal representative, the passport of the foreign shareholder and the stated business scope so the registry can confirm that the proposed activity does not fall under the Foreign Investment Negative List. The application must be executed with the digital signature of the legal representative.
required_dossiers: Chinese identity or business license of Chinese shareholder
Statement of business scope and industry category
Consent of legal representative to serve
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected as identical or confusingly similar, the applicant may amend the proposed name and resubmit to the same SAMR portal within five business days of the written query. If rejection is founded on a prohibited word, the applicant may apply for a new name after legal adjustment. No registration fee is incurred.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Authentication of Joint Venture Contract and Articles of Association; Foreign Investment Information Report
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: SAMR Integrated Enterprise Registration Portal and Ministry of Commerce Foreign Investment Comprehensive Management Information System
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The board shall prepare the final Chinese-language Joint Venture Contract and Articles of Association, together with a notarized English translation for internal corporate records. Each shareholder must execute the documents: a board resolution or sole-owner decision for corporate shareholders, and a notarized signature for individuals. Foreign public documents, including certificate of incorporation, incumbency and passport copies, must be apostilled under the Hague Apostille Convention effective in China. Once executed, the foreign investor shall file the foreign investment information report through the SAMR integrated portal or through the MOFCOM system, providing investor nationality, actual controller information, investment amount and business scope. Any regulatory query on completeness must be cured before proceeding to incorporation registration.
required_dossiers: Foreign shareholder board resolution or ownership consent
Apostilled certificate of incorporation and incumbency for foreign corporate shareholder
Apostilled passport copies of foreign shareholders and directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the foreign investment information report is queried for completeness or missing apostille, the Company shall submit the missing item through the same portal within ten business days. If the investor is located in a jurisdiction outside the Apostille Convention, consular legalization through the Chinese embassy or consulate is required. Failure to cure leads to rejection; administrative review may be requested.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Establishment Registration and Business License Issuance
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After name reservation and execution of governing documents, the designated representative shall submit the Company Establishment Registration Application Form to SAMR together with the original Articles of Association, the list and identity certificates of directors, supervisors and the legal representative, registered address proof, shareholder qualification files and the official name reservation notification. SAMR reviews the legality of the application, requests rectification if inconsistencies appear and, upon satisfaction, issues the Business License for Enterprise Legal Person. The issuance date is the statutory date of incorporation of the Joint Venture. After issuance, the Company obtains its unified social credit code and begins legal existence required to apply for post-incorporation permits and open bank accounts.
required_dossiers: Appointment resolutions for directors, legal representative and supervisor
Passport and identity documents of appointed officers
Registered office lease and property ownership certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If SAMR issues a rectification notice, the applicant must amend the defective schedule and resubmit within the stated statutory rectification period. If SAMR refuses to register, the applicant may request administrative reconsideration within 60 days before the local government or the same SAMR authority, or file an administrative lawsuit within six months.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Seal Carving, Tax Registration, Banking, Social Insurance and Foreign Exchange Filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Public Security Bureau licensed seal engraving enterprise; local office of the State Taxation Administration; People's Bank of China regulated bank; State Administration of Foreign Exchange through the designated bank
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon receipt of the Business License, the Company must carve the company seal, financial seal, contract seal and legal representative seal at a PSB-licensed engraving shop and file the seal record. Within 30 days after the date on the Business License, the Company must complete tax registration at the local State Taxation Administration office and activate electronic invoicing. The Company must open a basic deposit account in a People's Bank of China regulated bank, complete anti-money laundering KYC, and then complete SAFE registration for the foreign shareholder's capital contribution and current account transactions. In parallel, the employer shall complete social insurance registration. If the Company will invoice foreign clients for CAD and BIM services, the bank must be notified of the target payment rails including wire transfer and Wise.
required_dossiers: Business License for Enterprise Legal Person
KYC and beneficial ownership forms for bank account
Foreign exchange registration application and JV contract
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If tax or seal registration is blocked, the Company must appear before the local State Taxation Administration office and digitally update the unified social credit code. If SAFE defers capital account registration, the bank must supplement the KYC pack and resubmit under SAFE procedures. Late filings may attract late fees; the Company should preserve all dated receipts and correction notices.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration of the People's Republic of China (STA), operating through the National Unified Electronic Tax Administration (e-Tax) portal for all corporate tax registrations, VAT arrangements, and export refund/zero-rating filings.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: The Sino-Foreign Equity Joint Venture (CN_JV_LTD) is incorporated with the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) under the multi-license integration reform. The business license issued contains the Unified Social Credit Code (USCC), which China recognizes as the sole statutory Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) and VAT registration number. Upon incorporation, SAMR automatically transmits registration data to the STA, completing the mandatory tax registration without a separate certificate. For foreign non-resident entities that do not establish a Chinese enterprise but have China-sourced income, the local STA office must be approached to complete non-resident enterprise tax registration and obtain a non-resident tax identification number before any withholding tax can be paid on their behalf. The JV must then complete VAT taxpayer status filing through the e-Tax portal, apply for the digital tax-control account if full digitized e-invoicing is needed, and register for corporate income tax, individual income tax withholding, and payroll/social contributions as part of the initial payroll setup.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None with respect to entity classification. China does not provide a US-style check-the-box election for Sino-foreign joint ventures; CN_JV_LTD is automatically a Chinese resident enterprise subject to entity-level Enterprise Income Tax on worldwide income. A VAT taxpayer may elect general taxpayer status before the mandatory RMB 5,000,000 annual turnover threshold if accounting records are sound. No hybrid mismatch election exists; cross-border hybrid mismatches are handled under the Enterprise Income Tax Law special tax adjustment and anti-avoidance provisions.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VAT registration is mandatory upon business establishment regardless of turnover. For general VAT taxpayer status, the statutory registration threshold is annual taxable turnover of RMB 5,000,000; below this threshold the taxpayer is normally a small-scale VAT taxpayer, but may elect general taxpayer status. The applicable VAT rate for the engineering design, BIM, and structural drafting services supplied by CN_JV_LTD is 6% (modern services rate), not the 13% general goods rate.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: China operates the Golden Tax Phase IV system. Taxpayers issue fully digital e-invoices through the STA's unified Electronic Invoice Service Platform, with real-time API-based transmission of invoice data to the tax authority's digital tax-control account. Each e-invoice carries a dynamically generated anti-counterfeit QR code and unique invoice number; physical stamping is not required. General VAT taxpayers must complete the digital tax-control account setup and use the e-Tax portal for invoicing, VAT returns, and export zero-rating/refund declarations; non-compliant invoice data is automatically blocked or flagged for audit.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: CN_JV_LTD may claim 0% VAT on cross-border supply of engineering design, BIM, and structural drafting services only when the recipient is an overseas entity, the services are wholly consumed outside of China, and the services qualify under the STA's cross-border zero-rating catalogue for offshore services and design services. The JV must satisfy the 'fully consumed overseas' test through evidence such as the offshore contract, service scope, place of actual performance, overseas recipient's identity, and foreign exchange receipt. If any part of the service is used in or related to real property or construction located in China, or if the recipient is a Chinese resident entity, zero-rating is denied and the 6% VAT liability applies.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Export Goods Customs Declaration Form (Customs Export Declaration) for physical exports; not required for pure offshore services unless the service is delivered via tangible media
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing export movement for goods; for pure services, a service delivery and acceptance certificate
Commercial invoice and detailed BIM/drafting service statement
Offshore service contract or purchase order with the overseas recipient
Bank foreign exchange receipt certificate / inward remittance certificate (foreign exchange repatriation voucher) evidencing receipt in the JV's registered bank account
Zero-rated VAT filing schedule submitted through the National Unified Electronic Tax Administration
Foreign exchange settlement confirmation issued by the bank under State Administration of Foreign Exchange monitoring rules
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Export zero-rating claims are scrutinized jointly by the STA, General Administration of Customs, and the State Administration of Foreign Exchange. If the required customs declaration, transport document, service delivery evidence, or foreign exchange repatriation receipt is missing or inconsistent, the claimed 0% treatment is reversed and VAT at 6% is assessed with daily late-payment interest. Fraudulent or unverified export zero-rating claims trigger recovery of the tax refund plus an administrative penalty of 50% to 5 times the tax amount under the Tax Administration Law; serious cases constitute the criminal offense of defrauding export tax rebates under Article 204 of the Criminal Law, punishable by imprisonment up to life imprisonment and confiscation of property.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE), a delegated foreign-exchange administration body of the People's Bank of China (PBOC)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: China operates under a managed floating RMB exchange-rate regime enforced by SAFE; the current account is liberalized for bona fide trade-in-services transactions, while the capital account remains controlled and requires case-by-case registration or approval. The Sino-Foreign Equity Joint Venture may freely settle export-derived BIM/CAD service fees into CNY or retain them in designated current-account FX positions, but every inflow and outflow must be supported by authentic trade contracts, invoices, and electronic delivery evidence. Profit remittance is permitted under a proof-first, anti-disguised-repatriation policy: dividends must be calculated from audited statutory financial statements, fully subjected to corporate income tax and any applicable withholding, evidenced by board minutes, and accompanied by SAFE remittance forms. The practical hurdle is not the legal ability to convert, but the administrative reality that banks act as the implementing agent of SAFE and will not execute a transaction without a clear underlying record. Capital injections have a separate currency route through the FDI foreign-exchange capital account and cannot be used for temporary liquidity or intercompany loans outside the registered business scope. Service-export credits are scrutinized for round-tripping, fake billing, and possible disguised capital inflow/outflow, requiring banks to maintain complete source-and-use documentation for every settlement.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: All export-related foreign-exchange receipts must be repatriated to China within 90 days after the date of service completion or, for goods, the date of customs export declaration; the designated bank may grant a one-time 90-day extension for valid commercial reasons and SAFE-recorded cases. As of 2012, SAFE abolished forced surrender, so the mandatory conversion ratio is 0%: the JV may retain 100% of export proceeds in a current-account foreign-exchange deposit account or sell any portion to an authorized domestic bank at the prevailing market rate. Each receipt must be reconciled against SAFE's trade-monitoring database using the export contract, invoice, proof of delivery or BIM/CAD transmittal, and payment instruction.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Foreign Exchange Capital Account (FDI) plus Basic CNY Operating Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Limited (ICBC)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: CNY Basic Operating Account plus Current Account FX Settlement Account
Trade Settlement and Letters of Credit Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Fintech EMIs such as Wise and other non-bank digital wallet providers are legally barred from acting as the onshore treasury account institution for this CJV in mainland China. They do not hold a Chinese deposit-taking banking licence and cannot satisfy PBOC or SAFE reporting obligations for the entity; their services can only appear as offshore payment sub-rails after the domestic bank has executed the CNY/FX conversion. Therefore, the JV must maintain its operational, capital and remittance accounts in a Tier-1 licensed domestic bank, with fintech tools limited to off-channel encashment by non-resident employees or non-Chinese suppliers.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: A physical branch interview is mandatory: at a minimum, the legal representative and the ultimate beneficial owner or their authorised corporate officer must appear in person at the chosen bank outlet with original passports/ID and proof of address. Remote consular proxy opening is not accepted as a stand-alone route for an onshore JV account. If the legal representative is an offshore director, the bank requires a notarized and consular-legalised power of attorney, a board resolution appointing the local account signatory, and a recorded video KYC interview; certain banks may also require a site visit to the JV's registered office to confirm actual operations before activating the account.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Multi-layer offshore parent and UBO chain opacity making source of wealth for the equity injection insufficient
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Group organisational chart; certificate of incorporation; memorandum and articles; UBO register transcript; audited parent financials or bank reference; six months of originating-bank statements showing remitted funds; notarised passport copies; sworn source-of-funds statement.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: BIM/CAD service billing anomalies such as high-value invoices with sparse delivery evidence or mismatch between SWIFT credits and contract milestones
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed master services agreement; itemised project work orders; milestone invoices; e-mail/file-transfer delivery logs; BIM/CAD file metadata and version history; client confirmation certificates; and a mapping of every SWIFT receipt to invoice and contract number.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Civil-infrastructure delivery touching OFAC, EU, UK or UN sanctioned regions or involving sensitive geospatial/proprietary engineering data
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Project end-user and end-use certificates; geographical coordinates and site description; sanctions-screening snapshot for all counterparties; export-compliance legal memorandum confirming no dual-use/controlled technology classification; and contractual prohibition on unauthorized onward disclosure.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Rapid conversion of FDI capital and early dividend remittance that resembles disguised round-tripping or unlawful capital outflow
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Audited Chinese statutory financial statements certified by a mainland CPA; corporate income tax returns and payment vouchers; board dividend approval; tax clearance or withholding certificates; SAFE foreign-exchange registration and remittance forms; bank statement proving the profits originated from true operating income.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The overseas parent must remit the JV equity via SWIFT MT103 to the JV's designated FDI foreign-exchange capital account in a Tier-1 domestic bank. Before the first deposit, the bank shall complete the FDI foreign-exchange registration in the SAFE digital platform and issue a foreign-exchange registration number. The payment narrative must state 'Equity Contribution to Registered Capital', with the applicable capital-project purpose code. After the remittance is credited and verified, a mainland licensed certified public accountant must perform capital verification and, once the CPA report is issued, the JV may apply to convert the capital into CNY under SAFE capital-account settlement rules. The converted funds may only be used for permitted business purposes and all underlying contracts, invoices and payment orders must be retained for audit; no third-party wallet, crypto bridge or non-bank fintech route may be used.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For trade settlements, the JV should use SWIFT MT103 for direct wire transfers to overseas BIM subcontractors, software licensing vendors and engineering consultants; commercial letters of credit (L/C at sight) for physical construction materials, hardware or equipment procurement from Chinese and foreign suppliers; and documentary collections (D/P or D/A) for low- to medium-risk invoice-based settlements with established counterparties. Cross-border CNY payments may be executed through CIPS (Cross-Border Interbank Payment System) under an RMB transaction, while foreign-currency disbursements must match the current-account trade declaration and pass the bank's authenticity review against contract, commercial invoice and proof of service delivery.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Conventional deliverable CNY/USD, CNY/EUR and CNY/HKD forward contracts on actual current-account export receivables or forecast trade commitments
FX swaps between CNY and foreign currency for near-term working-capital matching and current-account rebalancing
Cross-currency interest-rate and principal swaps for SAFE-approved long-term foreign-currency borrowing or project funding
Plain-vanilla currency options and simple option combinations purchased from a licensed domestic bank under real-demand hedging principles
No onshore non-deliverable forward (NDF) trading is permitted for the CNY-resident JV; the offshore parent may engage in CNH NDF outside mainland only as a separate offshore treasury strategy

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Enterprise Information Publicity Report (Annual Return) incorporating the Foreign-Invested Enterprise Annual Information Report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) and Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM), filed through the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 1 January through 30 June immediately following the reporting year, covering the prior calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing or omission triggers inclusion in the List of Enterprises with Abnormal Operation Status; after three consecutive abnormal years, the enterprise is placed on the List of Enterprises with Serious Illegal and Dishonest Acts, and its legal representative or responsible managers may be disqualified from serving in the same roles for three years. Failure to report, or false reporting, foreign investment information may lead to a rectification order and, if not rectified, an administrative fine of RMB 100,000 to RMB 500,000 under the PRC Foreign Investment Law. Persistent non-compliance can ultimately result in administrative revocation of the business license and forced deregistration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate Income Tax Annual Settlement Return, including related-party transaction disclosure forms and audited financial statement schedules
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) local in-charge tax authority through the electronic tax filing platform
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within five months after fiscal year-end, in all cases on or before 31 May of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty ranges from RMB 2,000 to RMB 10,000; late payment triggers a daily overdue surcharge of 0.05% on the unpaid tax from the statutory deadline. Understated or fraudulent CIT exposure carries an administrative penalty of 50% to 500% of the unpaid tax, together with interest, enforced bank-account freezes, asset seizures, exit-control blocking for responsible persons, tax registration cancellation, and denial of deregistration until all tax liabilities are settled.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Statutory Financial Statements Audit and Adoption of Certified Independent Auditor's Report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: A PRC-registered chartered CPA firm; audited financial statements are delivered to shareholders and retained for use by SAMR, MOFCOM and the STA in the annual and tax filings
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual financial statements must be audited and submitted to shareholders within four months after each fiscal year-end and, in all cases, before the 31 May CIT settlement deadline and the 30 June annual-report deadline
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to procure a statutory audit breaches Article 164 of the PRC Company Law; the unaudited financial statements cannot lawfully support the SAMR annual return, the foreign-investment information report, the CIT settlement, or profit remittance and foreign-exchange filings. Directors and supervisors may incur civil liability for untrue accounts, tax loss carry-forwards may be disallowed, and the company may be unable to obtain deregistration or tax clearance for a clean corporate exit.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Under Article 164 of the PRC Company Law, every PRC company, including this Sino-Foreign Equity Joint Venture, must have its annual financial statements independently audited by a legally established PRC-certified CPA firm. There is no size-based exemption for ordinary limited companies: a JV with zero turnover, zero balance-sheet assets, or zero employees still requires an annual audit. Quantitative triggers commonly treated as mandatory by regulators and lending/credit authorities include: (a) total assets exceeding RMB 50 million; (b) annual turnover exceeding RMB 30 million; or (c) more than 100 employees, each independently compelling audited financial statements for licensing, credit, tax, or foreign-exchange reviews. Loss-making enterprises, negative net-asset companies, and any enterprise seeking to remit profits abroad through the bank/Foreign Exchange Administration channel must additionally hold certified audited accounts.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: PRC Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises (ASBE), substantially converged with IFRS as issued by the Ministry of Finance; qualified small enterprises may instead apply the Accounting Standards for Small-Sized Enterprises (ASSE), but a Sino-Foreign Equity JV choosing IFRS-based consolidated reporting for its foreign parent must nevertheless maintain its PRC statutory books and annual audit in ASBE and RMB.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under the PRC Beneficial Owner Information Filing regime and the Foreign Investment Information Reporting Measures, the JV must complete an annual confirmation through the integrated 1 January to 30 June SAMR/MOFCOM annual report, confirming its shareholders, direct owners, beneficial owners, capital structure and control chain. In addition, any shareholding transfer or change in beneficial ownership must be filed with SAMR within 30 calendar days after the underlying share-registry amendment or ownership change takes effect. The JV must maintain an internal UBO register and reconcile it with the filed data at least annually; false or omitted UBO filings are subject to a rectification order and fines of up to RMB 500,000.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Shareholders) kept at the registered office
Register of Charges and Mortgages over company assets and share pledges
Statutory Minute Book containing shareholders' meeting and board meeting resolutions
Register of Equity Transfers, Pledges and Beneficial Ownership Changes

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% standard Enterprise Income Tax (EIT) rate under Article 4 of the Enterprise Income Tax Law of the People's Republic of China (EITL), applicable to the China-resident Sino-Foreign Equity Joint Venture (JV).
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No general statutory tax holiday for standard foreign-invested enterprises in China Mainland; targeted incentives include a 15% High and New Technology Enterprise rate, a 15% Western Region encouraged-industry rate, a 5% effective rate for qualified Small Low-Profit Enterprises with taxable income up to RMB 3 million, a 100% additional deduction for qualifying R&D expenses, and software enterprise incentives only if the JV independently qualifies. CAD/BIM civil-infrastructure drafting generally qualifies as an ordinary engineering service income unless genuine R&D or software-development substance is established.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Enterprise Income Tax Annual Return Type A (A Category Annual Enterprise Income Tax Return, core Form A100000 with applicable support schedules A1050xx and A1070xx), filed electronically on the State Taxation Administration China e-Taxation Platform electronic tax bureau or submitted locally; the Annual Related Party Transactions Reporting Form must be enclosed with the annual return.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual final settlement return, supported by quarterly provisional Enterprise Income Tax payments within the same fiscal year.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Quarterly provisional returns and payments are due within 15 calendar days after the end of each quarter; the annual final settlement return is due on or before 31 May of the following calendar year; related-party transaction disclosure and contemporaneous transfer pricing documentation must be prepared before the 31 May filing date.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross revenue from civil infrastructure engineering services, CAD drafting, and BIM modeling performed by the JV, including all service fees invoiced to non-resident clients.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report export service revenue on a gross basis, converted to RMB using the spot exchange rate on the invoice or revenue recognition date; do not net out foreign withholding taxes, overseas subcontractor costs, or parent-company overhead. The JV must verify that services performed by non-resident personnel or through offshore delivery centres do not create a Chinese permanent establishment or misstate the place of supply.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Direct production costs, subcontractor drafting charges, cloud and software costs, staff costs, and amortization of BIM/CAD systems.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: All intercompany recharges must be supported by written agreements and contemporaneous transfer pricing evidence. Undocumented payments to offshore related parties for phantom subcontracting or data-processing will be denied and recharacterised as non-deductible distributions or taxable income of the JV.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: PRC value-added-tax-related surcharges, urban maintenance and construction tax, education surcharge, property tax, stamp duty, and other non-income taxes.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Do not deduct foreign income tax or withholding tax borne on behalf of non-resident recipients, except where the JV validly elects and substantiates foreign tax credit treatment under EITL Article 23. VAT on cross-border service exports must be reconciled against zero-rating exemption conditions.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Marketing, tender, business development, and bid-related expenses for civil infrastructure projects.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Commission or finder fees paid to non-resident agents must be arm's length, functionally substantiated, and analysed for treaty and withholding risk if the agent is deemed to have a Chinese permanent establishment or to provide services sourced in China.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Management salaries, office costs, IT systems, legal, audit, and professional fees.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Group management fees and headquarters costs recharged by a foreign parent must satisfy the actual-service test under STA Bulletin 2017 No. 6; reimbursement of shareholders' own supervisory costs or parent stewardship costs is non-deductible and may be treated as a disguised dividend.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Interest expense, guarantee fees, bank charges, and foreign exchange losses on borrowings and related-party loans.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Interest paid to non-resident related lenders is subject to thin-capitalisation limits; for non-financial enterprises the safe-harbour related-party debt-to-equity ratio is 2:1. Disallowed excess interest is added back and the payer must still withhold on the gross interest remitted to the non-resident lender. Treaty reduction requires a valid Tax Residency Certificate and beneficial ownership proof.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computed operating profit after operating costs, taxes, selling expenses, administrative expenses, and financial expenses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the operating margin is persistently lower than similarly situated independent engineering services firms while outbound payments to affiliates are high, the State Taxation Administration may apply the transactional net margin method or another arm's-length method to adjust profit and impose interest at the benchmark rate plus 5 percentage points under EITL Article 48.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 8 / Line 9 - Non-Operating Income and Non-Operating Expenditure
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gains and losses outside ordinary operating activity, including asset disposals, donations, penalties, and waivers.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Forgiveness of intercompany debt, release from liabilities, or capital contributions by non-resident shareholders can be recharacterised as taxable income or capital contribution; all such events must be documented in board resolutions and reflected at fair value.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net pre-tax accounting profit under PRC Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A sustained accounting loss in a JV that continuously pays fees and interest to offshore related parties is a classic red flag; tax authorities will scrutinise the business purpose, retained capital, pricing, and functional/risk profile.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 11 / Line 12 - Tax Adjustment Increase / Tax Adjustment Decrease
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Reconciliation items converting accounting profit into taxable income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Add back non-deductible amounts such as excessive entertainment expense, fines, excess related-party interest, undocumented service fees, unrecognised royalties, and transfer pricing adjustments; deduct qualifying amounts such as R&D super deduction and tax-exempt interest.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 13 - Tax Exemptions and Reduced-Income Items
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Enterprises Income Tax exemptions, reduced-rate income, and super deductions for qualifying R&D and other statutory incentives.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The JV must maintain eligibility files and contemporaneous R&D project records if claiming high-tech enterprise or R&D deduction benefits. Non-resident shareholders cannot directly enjoy these JV-level incentives unless the payments flow through a Chinese taxable establishment.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 14 / Line 15 - Taxable Income after Loss Offset
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net taxable income after applying the statutory carryforward loss limitation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: General loss carryforward is five years, extended only for qualifying High and New Technology and certain strategic enterprises; cross-border group loss sharing is not permitted, and the JV may not surrender losses to its foreign parent or sister entities.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final positive taxable income after all statutory adjustments and prior-year loss offsets.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The taxable income must be economically consistent with the JV's functions, assets, and risks. Non-resident-controlled engineering outsourcing arrangements that strip profit through low-margin drafting operations will be adjusted to reflect an arm's-length return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 18 / Line 19 - Applicable Tax Rate and Computed Tax Payable
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Application of 25% standard rate or approved preferential rate to taxable income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If an applicable treaty or domestic preferential rate is claimed, attach all approvals. Non-resident director fees and independent-service fees paid by the JV are still subject to withholding obligations, including possible 10% non-resident EIT.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 20 / Line 21 - Tax Credits and Foreign Tax Credit
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Preferential domestic credits and allowable foreign income tax credit.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign tax credit is capped at the PRC EIT otherwise payable on foreign-source income; no credit is allowed for tax avoided through a treaty-shopping structure or for amounts recoverable by refund application.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 22 / Line 23 / Line 24 - Net Tax Payable, Prior Prepayments, and Balance Due or Refund
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final annual EIT liability after quarterly provisional payments and withholding credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Any dividend resolved to non-resident shareholders triggers a 10% gross-basis withholding obligation that must be discharged before remittance. The withheld sum is payable to the Chinese treasury; treaty reduction may be claimed only with a current Tax Residency Certificate, beneficial ownership declaration, and no conduit arrangement.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of the annual return is penalised under Tax Administration Law Article 62 by a fine of up to RMB 2,000, or RMB 2,000 to RMB 10,000 for serious cases. Late tax payment attracts a daily surcharge of 0.05% of the unpaid tax. Submission of false or inflated cost records leading to underpayment of tax can trigger recovery of unpaid tax plus a fine of 50% to 5 times the tax evaded under Tax Administration Law Article 63. Inadequate transfer pricing documentation and related-party reporting allow the tax authority to make deemed adjustments and to impose interest at the benchmark rate plus 5 percentage points. Criminal fraud thresholds are assessed under Criminal Law Article 201 where the evasion amount is large and exceeds 10% of taxable tax payable, with imprisonment of up to three years; for huge amounts exceeding 30%, imprisonment of three to seven years plus fines.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% statutory withholding rate on gross dividends paid by a China-resident enterprise to a non-resident enterprise recipient, subject to reduction under an applicable bilateral tax treaty only if the recipient is the beneficial owner.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: The JV must require the non-resident payee to: (1) deliver a valid Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) issued by its home jurisdiction competent authority; (2) complete the STA treaty-relief form declaring tax residence and beneficial ownership; (3) provide audited or evidentiary proof of economic substance, including staff, office, decision-making, risk assumption, and absence of any contractual, legal, or factual obligation to pass the payment to a third-party resident; (4) submit the package to the JV before remittance for reduced-rate withholding at source; and (5) if the reduced rate was not applied at source, file a refund claim within three years under Article 51 of the Tax Administration Law. Treaty benefits are denied for conduits lacking real business activity under STA Bulletin 2018 No. 9 and the general anti-avoidance rule in EITL Article 47.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: The statutory rate for outbound interest and royalties paid by the JV to non-resident enterprises is 10% EIT, plus Chinese VAT at 6% on taxable cross-border payments where applicable; treaty-reduced rates are commonly 5% or 10%, sometimes 0% or 7% for interest/royalties depending on the treaty partner and beneficial ownership. Royalties for use of CAD/BIM software and designs are recharacterised if the payment in substance purchases IP or services; all such payments require a TRC, beneficial ownership analysis, PE review, and source-withholding compliance.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Under SAT Announcement 2016 No. 42, the Local File is statutorily required when annual related-party transactions exceed RMB 200 million for tangible property transfers, RMB 100 million for intangible property transfers, RMB 100 million for financial-asset transfers, or RMB 40 million for other related-party transactions; the Master File is required when total cross-border related-party transactions exceed RMB 1 billion or when the ultimate parent is obliged to prepare a group Master File, and the annual related-party transaction reporting schedule is required whenever any reportable related-party relationship exists.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: China applies an economic-substance and substance-over-form doctrine through EITL Articles 41, 46, and 47 and STA Bulletin 2017 No. 6. Intra-group service fees must have actual service delivery, commercial value, and be free of shareholder duplication. Core income-generating activities in China include contract negotiation, engineering performance, project management, risk control, and CAD/BIM production. A shell JV that merely signs contracts and routes profits offshore while lacking employees, premises, decision-making, and risk will fail the functional and economic-substance analysis and be recharacterised, and treaty benefits under the beneficial ownership test will be denied.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion Through Concealed Cross-Border Engineering Revenue and False Invoicing
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The JV deliberately omits, under-invoices, or redirects revenue from BIM/CAD civil-infrastructure services to a related offshore entity, or inflates deductions with fictitious invoices for phantom software, consultancy, or subcontract services, causing underpayment of Enterprise Income Tax and VAT.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Tax Administration Law Article 63 requires recovery of the unpaid tax plus a fine of 50% to 5 times the tax evaded and daily late-payment surcharge of 0.05%. Criminal Law Article 201 imposes imprisonment of up to three years or criminal detention plus fines where the evasion is relatively large and exceeds 10% of payable tax; three to seven years and heavier fines apply where the amount is especially large and exceeds 30% of payable tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The corporate veil may be pierced under PRC Company Law Article 23 if the director or controlling shareholder abuses limited liability; the director can be personally liable for unpaid taxes and damages to creditors. The legal representative or actual controller may be placed on the serious tax violation blacklist and subjected to an exit-control/travel ban under Tax Administration Law Article 44, barred from senior management roles, and, if criminal liability is established, sentenced to imprisonment with seizure of personal assets and potential foreign-residency consequences.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing Documentation Failure and Thin Capitalisation / Interest Stripping
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The JV makes above-arm's-length payments of management fees, engineering service fees, royalties, and interest to non-resident related parties without contemporaneous Local File/Master File documentation, without functional and risk analysis, with backdated intercompany agreements, and in disregard of the 2:1 related-party debt-to-equity thin-capitalisation rule.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The tax authority may recharacterise the transactions and adjust taxable income under EITL Article 41, disallow excess interest under Article 46, and impose interest at the benchmark rate plus 5 percentage points under Article 48. Failure to maintain transfer pricing documentation and annual related-party disclosure triggers penalties under Tax Administration Law Articles 62 to 64, including fines up to RMB 10,000 for non-filing and 50% to 5 times tax underpayment penalties if the defect causes underpayment; daily surcharges continue until full payment.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: A director who knowingly signs false TP documentation or moves intercompany prices for personal gain can be found personally liable for restitution to the company and creditors, may be included in the tax blacklisting and exit-control system, and may face criminal liability for tax evasion under Criminal Law Article 201 or embezzlement under Article 271, including imprisonment up to seven years and confiscation or attachment of personal assets.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Conduit and Treaty Shopping on Dividend Repatriation
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The JV distributes reserve profits to an offshore conduit parent company with no employees, no premises, no business activity, no real decision-making, and no capacity to perform substantive functions, while the dividends are pre-arranged to flow onward to an ultimate beneficial owner in a low-tax territory solely to obtain reduced treaty withholding rates.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Reduced treaty rates are denied under STA Bulletin 2018 No. 9 and EITL Article 47; the tax authority may recompute the JV's taxable income and recapture withholding tax at the statutory 10% rate, plus daily surcharges and a fine of 50% to 5 times the under-withheld tax under Tax Administration Law Article 63. The denial applies retroactively, with possible additional adjustment for another ten years in serious avoidance cases.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and controlling persons who approve disguised distributions are civilly liable for damages to the company, minority shareholders, and creditors; the legal representative or actual controller will be placed on the tax blacklist and prevented from leaving China until the tax is settled. If conduit structuring is used to conceal taxable income and divert funds to personal offshore accounts, criminal liability under Criminal Law Article 201 may result in imprisonment of up to seven years, monetary fines, and judicial enforcement against personal assets, including through cross-border mutual legal assistance.
